summary: Specifies the protocol an IPv6 router uses to discover which neighboring nodes want to receive multicast packets, and which multicast addresses they are interested in. It is the IPv6 counterpart of IGMP. It is a standards-track protocol at the proposed standard level.

eli5.summary: A teacher asks who wants to hear each announcement and writes down the hands that go up. MLD is how a router asks that question on a network.

questions: how does ipv6 multicast membership work
